description: AI Engineering course capstone requiring a working system and measurable evaluation.
prompt: We are two intermediate students taking an AI Engineering course. We have 30 days and laptops to build a capstone using Python, open-source tools, and public data. We are interested in LLM applications and RAG, but cannot train a large model or depend on expensive paid APIs. Give us three final project ideas with a clear evaluation plan.

must_satisfy: runs with open-source or low-cost components
forbidden_outcomes: requires training a large foundation model
